description.intro: The 3rd Benfica 26 27 adidas T-shirt features a design inspired by the lights of the Benfica Campus and pays tribute to the young talent and future generations of the Portuguese club. Its black base creates a stark contrast with the abstract graph of spray effect in pink and red tones that runs asymmetrically through different areas of the T-shirt.

Inspiration in the future: His aesthetic pays tribute to Benfica Campus, its young talents and the new generations.
Modern aesthetics: The asymmetrical application of the print adds personality to this third equipment.
Football style: A shirt designed to show the passion for Benfica inside and outside the field.
